title: Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes the sufferings of 2 Corinthians 6:3-7 (troubles, hardships, beatings, imprisonments, riots, hard work, sleepless nights, hunger), the virtues Paul names (purity, understanding, patience, kindness, sincere love, truthful speech), and how to stand firm today.

floor.prerequisite: Knows how Peter and John stood firm.
floor.question: What did Peter and John say when told to stop speaking about Jesus?

contexts: a pastor serving in a hard place

board.do: Draw two columns: hardships and virtues.

board.say: Name a virtue Paul showed in hardship.

board.do: Wait for the child to say patience or kindness.

misconceptions.ask: Why did the apostles suffer (2 Corinthians 6:3-7)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 2 Corinthians 6:4: "as servants of God we commend ourselves in great endurance". They suffered for serving.

misconceptions.ask: Which is in Paul's list of hardships?
misconceptions.repair: Read 6:4-5 and list the hardships on the board: troubles, beatings, prisons, riots, hunger.

misconceptions.ask: Which virtue does Paul name (2 Corinthians 6:6)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 6:6 and list the virtues: purity, understanding, patience, kindness, sincere love.

misconceptions.ask: What did Paul do after beatings and prisons (2 Corinthians 6:4-7)?
misconceptions.repair: Read 6:4-7 as one long sentence: all these hardships, and still patience, kindness, truthful speech.

checks.question: Name one virtue Paul names in 2 Corinthians 6:6.
